articles.summary: WALTHAM, Mass., Nov. 04, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Repligen Corporation (NASDAQ:RGEN), today announced that it will participate in the Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference in London, UK. Olivier Loeillot, President and Chief Executive Officer, will participate in an analyst-led discussion on November 18 th at 2:00 p.m. GMT. A live webcast of the conference presentation will be accessible through Repligen’s Investor Relations website and will be available for replay for a limited period of time following the event. About Repligen Corporation Repligen Corporation is a global bioprocessing company that develops and commercializes innovative technologies and integrated solutions that support critical steps in the manufacturing and delivery of biologic drugs that improve human health worldwide.
